high_level_description: stc brand style, a modern office meeting scene with three people at a conference table in front of a large surreal space mural.

A Middle Eastern woman in a hijab and purple clothing, a Black man in a denim jacket, and a Middle Eastern man in traditional white Arab dress, depicted within the mural artwork.
